title: Earliest track: Production expands to thirty per cent
notes: Adds prod-us-east-02 at fifteen per cent, taking Production from fifteen to thirty. Third point on the accelerating curve of 5, 15, 30, 60, 100.
Staging is already complete and its rules are restated unchanged, because targeting is declarative: each entry describes the whole desired state for that flag and environment rather than a delta.
Still cluster rules, not a fallthrough change. The terminal fully-rolled-out state is saved for s014 so the crossover stays legible.
The three open-track flags remain untouched and continue to crawl toward 5 October.
